info.name: SaiGame Unity API
info.description:
# SaiGame Unity API (debug)

Every HTTP endpoint the SaiGame Unity package (`Assets/SaiGame/Scripts`, v0.2.60c) calls. Use it to try a call
by hand, inspect real responses and compare them with what your game receives. Each request lists the Unity method
that calls it and has saved example responses.

## Quick start
1. Import this collection and `SaiGame.unity-api.postman_environment.json`, select the environment.
2. Set `api_url` (default `https://api.saigame.studio`, no `/api` suffix), `game_id`, `username`, `password`.
3. **01 Auth > Login** (or Register first). The token is saved to `access_token` automatically.
4. **02 Gamer Progress > Get my gamer progress** (or Create). The Unity client refuses every game API until
   gamer progress is loaded, so mirror that here.
5. Call anything else. List requests save the first result's ID (`shop_id`, `container_id`,
   `inventory_item_id`, `mailbox_message_id`, ...) for the detail/action requests; edit the variable to target
   another one.

## Headers sent by Unity
| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `X-Client-Version` | `sai-unity/0.2.60c` |
| `X-Client-ID` | `{{game_id}}` |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{access_token}}` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` on POST/PUT/PATCH |

Errors use `{ "error", "message", "message_code" }`.

## Variables you may need to fill in
`recipe_key`, `gacha_pack_id`, `gacha_code`, `gift_code`, `preset_definition_id`, `battle_script_name`,
`steam_ticket` (fresh, single-use ticket from a running Steam client).

Purchases, crafting, gacha, claims and **Delete my gamer progress** change real data — debug on a test game.

`ticket` is a hex Steam Web API auth ticket from `SteamUser.GetAuthTicketForWebApi` (see `SteamTicketService`); it is single-use and short-lived — set `steam_ticket` right before each request.
